Summy, my hermosa reina, it's been a long time with you and I loved and cherished each and every moment with you my love. You are literally the best girl and the best thing that has happened to me, I swear when I say I've never loved someone like I've loved you. My love — I always tried to give my best to you, and it will always remain the same, and I'll try to love you even better mi amor :3. Sometimes it's really hard to type how much I love you cuz you are literally my whole life, and maybe sometimes I wasn't able to understand how you feel. I really feel bad for it :( I might not be enough to comfort and help you sometimes, but I always try my best. I'm at a bit of peace after I told you how I really felt and you listened to me. Thanks for it, love :3. I hope our relation keeps getting deeper and deeper and never lets anyone come in between us. I would apologize to you for infinity times rather than losing you, cuz it's not about perfection, it's about never giving up on your loved ones. I know the girl I love, the girl I chose, deeply loves me and cares about me :3, and always will. I hope we keep our promises and never let each other go, cuz we've made a lot of promises and, yk, a lot of love. So for the sake of it, we must stay together forever now :) Te Amo Summyyyyyyyyyy ♥ I love you 3000 — more than it, and more than my life itself.

For Mi Esposa :3

A Poem

Remember me, when you see something beautiful, when you see something amazing, when you see me, when you finally put your beautiful gaze on me, my heart will go fire, melt like butter. The beautiful meadows with pink sky, wanna cherish every moment with you in them. I'm waiting for that when — when we'll finally be with each other, finally holding hands, sitting near the beautiful beach shore, with amor de mi vida. Every night, every day, miss you more, more n' more. My melancholy blues, my beautiful melody, my heart aches for you — for your embrace, for your touch, for your love, for you. I just want to be with you, forever. The love I have for you is higher than the highest mountain peak, and the only thing I seek is your love, mi amor. I love listening to your sound, like a beautiful melody. You are my goddess, I'm your devotee, I devote myself to you, and only you. Aishiteru ♥
